[P3] Resolve the untested configuration branch

`CONTRIBUTING.md` rule 4 requires a test that fails without each new branch. The wiring tests only read this handler's source, and the deployed template supplies the environment variable, so neither checks the missing/empty-variable failure behavior added here. For example, accepting an empty value would leave every wiring assertion passing. Return to the design phase as required by rule 9: decide whether this validation belongs in the deploy-only fixture, then support it with a failing behavioral test or simplify away the branch.
